title: Native tensor representatives before derived closedness
statement: Fix a finite field k0, a prime l different from its characteristic, a k0-scheme X, native closed Hom models M, an ordinary closed structure S, a native derived monoidal structure m, and tensor-forgetting comparison t [def-sf-native-weil-closed-models]. NativeTensorKFlat(T,P) means total(T,P,N) is acyclic for every acyclic N. NativeWeilTensorPresentation consists of an additive underived tensor T, a parameterized adjunction to the specified native ihomBifunctor, evaluation-normalized ordinary forgetting, localization of K-flat complexes, preservation of K-flatness by forgetting, natural one-K-flat derived tensor models, ordinary models normalized for S, and a chain tensor-forgetting isomorphism whose homogeneous summands and localization agree with t. It asserts no existence and contains no native derived adjunction or derived Hom comparison.
